chapter: 灾病缠脱章第七十至医家治病章第七十三
chapter_en: Chapters 70-73: illness that clings, escaping the heat, seeking a doctor, the doctor treating

units.chapter_en: Chapter 70: Illness that clings and illness that leaves
units.title: 缠身与脱体：鬼兴鬼动定缠绵、随官入墓助鬼伤身终难脱、世受官伤成痼疾、子孙一动立时安；六冲旦夕灾殃散、无鬼病不缠、鬼空无疾厄、忌神旺发患多年、鬼化福神他日解、用象兴隆祸不干

rule.yi: 以福神为主，用象为凭。身处灾难、相貌残损，鬼兴鬼动，一定缠绵不去；随官入墓，终究难脱；助鬼伤身，永不痊愈；世爻受官鬼所伤，成为痼疾；子孙一动，立刻安好。六冲的卦，灾殃旦夕就散；没有鬼，病终究不缠；鬼如果空亡，没有疾厄；忌神旺相发动，病患延续多年；鬼变出福神，他日就解；用象兴隆，祸事不相干。注说：占带不带疾，最嫌官鬼兴隆，官鬼如果旺相，病一定缠身，纵然不旺相，发动也是这样；若遇上随官入墓、或助鬼伤身，必成痼疾；鬼克世爻也难脱体；如果得到子孙旺相、或发动、或持世、或临日月，病就离身。六冲的卦，这个病容易消，合处逢冲的后来才解；鬼不上卦以及落空亡，永远没有殃疾；纵然有鬼象，如果变出福神，眼下虽然凶，后来当解脱；虽然凭官鬼，也要看用爻，用爻遇旬空月破，病也难痊愈；土象休囚，又被忌神发动，岂不成凶？用爻纵然弱，如果遇上动出元神，虽然有这个灾，决不至损寿；用爻父母若得兴隆，官鬼又居衰地，起初虽然见病，终究不成殃。
rule.en: The fortune spirit is the main line, and the Subject image is the ground. The body in trouble, the features worn and disfigured; the ghost thriving and moving surely clings and lingers; following the Pressure line into a tomb, it is hard in the end to shake off; helping the ghost to harm the Self, it never heals; the Self wounded by Pressure becomes a chronic illness; when Output moves, ease comes at once. A Six-Clash hexagram disperses calamity by morning or evening; with no ghost the illness in the end does not cling; if the ghost is Void there is no illness; the Adversary strong and moving makes an affliction of many years; a ghost that changes into the fortune spirit is resolved some day later; the Subject image thriving, misfortune does not touch. The commentary says: for whether one carries an illness or not, most feared is a thriving Pressure line; if the Pressure line is strong the illness surely clings to the body, and even if it is not strong the same is true if it moves; meeting following into a tomb or helping the ghost to harm the Self, it will surely become a chronic illness; a ghost controlling the Self line also can hardly be shaken off; if Output is strong, or moves, or holds the Self, or sits on the Day or Month, the illness leaves the body. A Six-Clash hexagram makes this ailment easy to dispel, and a clash met in a combination is resolved only later; if the ghost is absent from the hexagram or falls into Void, there will never be affliction; even if there is a ghost image, if it changes into the fortune spirit, though it is ominous for the moment it will be resolved later; though one relies on the Pressure line, one must also look at the Subject line, and if the Subject meets Void or Month-break the illness too is hard to heal; if an Earth image is resting or trapped and the Adversary moves, how can it fail to be ominous? Though the Subject line is weak, if the Support comes out moving, then although there is this calamity it does not cost life; if the Resource line as Subject is thriving and the Pressure line sits in a weak place, then although at first there is illness, in the end it does no harm.

zh: 以福神为主，用象为凭。
yi: 以福神为主，以用象为凭。
en: Output (the fortune spirit) is the main line, and the Subject image is the ground.

zh: 身处灾生相貌残，鬼兴鬼动定缠绵，
随官入墓终难脱，助鬼伤身永不痊，
世受官伤成痼疾，子孙一动立时安。
yi: 身处灾难、相貌残损，鬼兴鬼动，一定缠绵不去；
随官入墓，终究难脱；助鬼伤身，永不痊愈；
世爻受官鬼所伤，成为痼疾；子孙一动，立刻安好。
en: The body in trouble, the features worn and disfigured; the ghost thriving and moving surely clings and lingers;
following the Pressure line into a tomb, it is hard in the end to shake off; helping the ghost to harm the Self, it never heals;
the Self wounded by Pressure becomes a chronic illness; when Output moves, ease comes at once.

zh: 凡占带疾不带疾，最嫌官鬼兴隆，官如旺相，病必缠身，纵不旺相，发动亦然。
若值随官入墓、或助鬼伤身，必成痼疾。
鬼克世爻亦难脱体。
若得子孙旺相、或发动、或持世、或临日月，病得离身。
yi: 凡是占带不带疾，最嫌官鬼兴隆，官鬼如果旺相，病一定缠身，纵然不旺相，发动也是这样。
若遇上随官入墓、或助鬼伤身，必成痼疾。
鬼克世爻也难脱体。
如果得到子孙旺相、或发动、或持世、或临日月，病就离身。
en: For whether one carries an illness or not, most feared is a thriving Pressure line; if the Pressure line is strong the illness surely clings to the body, and even if it is not strong the same is true if it moves.
Meeting following into a tomb or helping the ghost to harm the Self, it will surely become a chronic illness.
A ghost controlling the Self line also can hardly be shaken off.
If Output is strong, or moves, or holds the Self, or sits on the Day or Month, the illness leaves the body.

zh: 六冲旦夕灾殃散，无鬼终须病不缠，
鬼若空亡无疾厄，忌神旺发患多年，
鬼化福神他日解，用象兴隆祸不干。
yi: 六冲的卦，旦夕灾殃就散；没有鬼，病终究不缠；
鬼如果空亡，没有疾厄；忌神旺相发动，病患延续多年；
鬼变出福神，他日就解；用象兴隆，祸事不相干。
en: A Six-Clash hexagram disperses calamity by morning or evening; with no ghost the illness in the end does not cling;
if the ghost is Void there is no illness; the Adversary strong and moving makes an affliction of many years;
a ghost that changes into Output (the fortune spirit) is resolved some day later; the Subject image thriving, misfortune does not touch.

zh: 六冲之卦，此患易消，合处逢冲后来方解。
鬼不上卦及落空亡，永无殃疾。
纵有鬼象，若变福神，目下虽凶，后当解脱。
虽凭官鬼，亦要看用爻，用值旬空月破，病亦难痊。
土象休囚，更被忌神发动，岂不成凶？
用爻纵弱，如逢动出元神，虽有此灾，决非损寿。
用父若得兴隆，官鬼又居衰地，始虽见病终不成殃。
yi: 六冲的卦，这个病容易消，合处逢冲的，后来才解。
鬼不上卦以及落空亡，永远没有殃疾。
纵然有鬼象，如果变出福神，眼下虽然凶，后来当解脱。
虽然凭官鬼，也要看用爻，用爻遇旬空月破，病也难痊愈。
土象休囚，又被忌神发动，岂不成凶？
用爻纵然弱，如果遇上动出元神，虽然有这个灾，决不至损寿。
用爻父母若得兴隆，官鬼又居衰地，起初虽然见病，终究不成殃。
en: A Six-Clash hexagram makes this ailment easy to dispel, and a clash met in a combination is resolved only later.
If the ghost is absent from the hexagram or falls into Void, there will never be affliction.
Even if there is a ghost image, if it changes into Output (the fortune spirit), though it is ominous for the moment it will be resolved later.
Though one relies on the Pressure line, one must also look at the Subject line, and if the Subject meets Void or Month-break the illness too is hard to heal.
If an Earth image is resting or trapped and the Adversary moves, how can it fail to be ominous?
Though the Subject line is weak, if the Support comes out moving, then although there is this calamity it does not cost life.
If the Resource line as Subject is thriving and the Pressure line sits in a weak place, then although at first there is illness, in the end it does no harm.

note.yi: 这一章问的是「病会不会缠身、能不能脱体」。章首小标是「以福神为主」（福神是子孙），这和上一大段以用神为主不同：这里要看的是病能不能被解掉，而解病的是子孙。「相貌残」是形容病人的身形样貌受损。「土象休囚，更被忌神发动」的「土象」是用神属土（占父母尊长等），读法没有把握。最后一句的「用父」是用爻为父母爻。与黄金策「世持鬼爻病纵轻而难疗」（LY.ILL.HJC.34）、易隐的轻重（LY.ILL.YY.16、YY.19）同一路读法。
note.en: This chapter asks whether the illness will cling to the body and whether it can leave it. The chapter's subtitle is 'the fortune spirit is the main line' (the fortune spirit being Output), which differs from the previous large passage, where the Subject was the main line: here what is looked at is whether the illness can be dissolved, and it is Output that dissolves it. 'Features worn and disfigured' describes the sick person's frame and appearance being damaged. In 'an Earth image resting or trapped and the Adversary moving' the 'Earth image' is the Subject being Earth (as in divining a parent or elder), the reading being uncertain. The 'Resource as Subject' in the last sentence means the Subject line is the Resource line. It reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's 'the Self holding the ghost, though the illness be light it is hard to treat' (LY.ILL.HJC.34) and the Yi Yin's light and heavy (LY.ILL.YY.16, YY.19).

units.chapter_en: Chapter 71: Warding off calamity and escaping the heat
units.title: 却灾避暑、养病悟道、修真：四者皆宜子动、各忌官兴；占己世爻休墓绝、问他用体怕空亡；子孙旺相或发动参禅避暑必如愿、官鬼交重旺相心求安反遭不测；用神遇月破旬空或临墓绝不惟无福反惹非殃

rule.yi: 以用爻为主，福德为凭。天行酷暑，难道没有避暑的办法？人染了患灾，也有躲灾的地方。悟道要选清闲的地方，修真要访幽僻的住处。这四样都宜子孙发动，各样都忌官鬼兴旺；占自己，怕世爻休囚墓绝，问别人，用爻和体怕空亡。注说：凡是占避暑、养病、悟道、修真这些事，都宜福德发动，各自忌讳官爻发动；占自己，以世爻为主，卜别人，以应象为凭；如果问亲人，要推用象，若临旺相、或遇生扶，却灾能脱身、悟道能成功；用神如果遇月破、旬空、或临墓绝，不光没有福，反而招来祸殃。子孙旺相或发动的，参禅打坐没有不成功的，避暑却灾必定如愿；官鬼交重或旺相的，心里想求安，反而遭遇不测。
rule.en: The Subject line is the main line, and the fortune spirit is the ground. When the heat of the season rages, is there not a way to escape it? When a person is infected with calamity, there is a place to ward it off. To realise the Way, choose a quiet and leisured place; to cultivate the truth, visit a secluded dwelling. For all four Output moving is favourable, and in each a thriving Pressure line is feared; in divining oneself, the Self line resting, in a tomb or in Extinction is feared, and in asking about another, the Subject and the body fearing Void. The commentary says: in all matters of escaping the heat, convalescing, realising the Way and cultivating the truth, the fortune spirit moving is favourable, and in each the Pressure line moving is feared; in divining oneself the Self line is the main line, and in divining another the Other image is the ground; if asking about a relative, work out the Subject image, and if it sits on strength or meets generation and support, one escapes calamity and the Way is achieved; if the Subject meets Month-break or Void, or sits in a tomb or Extinction, there is not only no blessing but a misfortune is brought on. With Output strong or moving, sitting in meditation is never without success, and escaping the heat and warding off calamity are sure to be as wished; with the Pressure line moving or strong, the heart seeks peace and on the contrary meets the unforeseen.

zh: 以用爻为主，福德为凭。
yi: 以用爻为主，以福德为凭。
en: The Subject line is the main line, and Output (the fortune spirit) is the ground.

zh: 天行酷暑，岂无避暑之方。
人染患灾，亦有却灾之所。
悟道择清闲之处，修真访幽僻之居。
四者皆宜子动，诸般各忌官兴，
占己世爻休墓绝，问他用体怕空亡。
yi: 天行酷暑，难道没有避暑的办法？
人染了患灾，也有躲灾的地方。
悟道要选清闲的地方，修真要访幽僻的住处。
这四样都宜子孙发动，各样都忌官鬼兴旺；
占自己，怕世爻休囚墓绝，问别人，用爻和体怕空亡。
en: When the heat of the season rages, is there not a way to escape it?
When a person is infected with calamity, there is a place to ward it off.
To realise the Way, choose a quiet and leisured place; to cultivate the truth, visit a secluded dwelling.
For all four Output moving is favourable, and in each a thriving Pressure line is feared;
in divining oneself, the Self line resting, in a tomb or in Extinction is feared, and in asking about another, the Subject and the body fearing Void.

zh: 凡占避暑、养病悟道、修真等事，皆宜福德交重，各忌官爻发动。
占自己，以世爻为主，卜他人，以应象为凭。
若问亲人，当推用象，如临旺相、或遇生扶，却灾得脱、悟道得成。
用神如遇月破旬空、或临墓绝，不惟无福，反惹非殃。
yi: 凡是占避暑、养病、悟道、修真这些事，都宜福德发动，各自忌讳官爻发动。
占自己，以世爻为主，卜别人，以应象为凭。
如果问亲人，要推用象，若临旺相、或遇生扶，却灾能脱身、悟道能成功。
用神如果遇月破、旬空、或临墓绝，不光没有福，反而招来祸殃。
en: In all matters of escaping the heat, convalescing, realising the Way and cultivating the truth, Output (the fortune spirit) moving is favourable, and in each the Pressure line moving is feared.
In divining oneself the Self line is the main line, and in divining another the Other image is the ground.
If asking about a relative, work out the Subject image, and if it sits on strength or meets generation and support, one escapes calamity and the Way is achieved.
If the Subject meets Month-break or Void, or sits in a tomb or Extinction, there is not only no blessing but a misfortune is brought on.

zh: 子孙发动好参禅，修心得道。
官鬼交重难避暑，养病反凶。
yi: 子孙发动好参禅，修心得道；
官鬼一发动，就难以避暑，养病反而凶险。
en: Output moving is good for meditation, and the mind is cultivated and the Way attained;
the Pressure line moving makes it hard to escape the heat, and convalescing is on the contrary ominous.

zh: 子孙旺相或发动者，参禅打坐无不成功，避暑却灾必如其愿。
官鬼交重或旺相者，心欲求安，反遭不测。
yi: 子孙旺相或发动的，参禅打坐没有不成功的，避暑却灾必定如愿。
官鬼交重或旺相的，心里想求安，反而遭遇不测。
en: With Output strong or moving, sitting in meditation is never without success, and escaping the heat and warding off calamity are sure to be as wished.
With the Pressure line moving or strong, the heart seeks peace and on the contrary meets the unforeseen.

note.yi: 这一章讲的不是已经生了病，而是躲灾避暑、养病、悟道、修真这类要去一处安静地方的事，所以它和疾病放在一起（「人染患灾，亦有却灾之所」）。「福德」是子孙。「用体」的「体」疑是身体；「用爻和体怕空亡」按字面译。「参禅」是坐禅修行，「修真」是道家修行。占自己以世为主，占别人以应为凭，和 LY.ILL.EL.18 是同一条。
note.en: This chapter is not about someone already ill, but about the matters that call for going to a quiet place — warding off calamity, escaping the heat, convalescing, realising the Way, cultivating the truth — and so it is put with illness ('when a person is infected with calamity, there is a place to ward it off'). 'Fortune spirit' is Output. The 'body' in 'the Subject and the body' looks like the physical body, and 'the Subject line and the body fearing Void' is translated literally. 'Meditation' is Chan sitting practice and 'cultivating the truth' is Daoist practice. That the Self is the main line in divining oneself and the Other the ground in divining another is the same rule as in LY.ILL.EL.18.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 71: Warding off calamity and escaping the heat
units.title: 避暑养病往何处：父母生世宜投书馆尊长、子孙生世利僧道卑幼、兄弟生世往弟兄朋友、妻财生世往妻族仆隶、官鬼生世宦宅；一卦皆安方是修行之路、六爻尽破岂为养静之窝；用爻旺遇青龙宜往、忌象兴加白虎莫往；随寓而安、六冲往返不定

rule.yi: 父母爻扶身，宜去书馆；福神生世，利于去僧堂。注说：父母爻生世，宜去文墨的地方和长辈的家；子孙生世，利于住在僧道的门下和晚辈小孩的地方；兄弟生世，宜去兄弟朋友的家；妻财生世，应去妻族亲友、仆隶下人的住处；官鬼生世，偏宜在官宦人家安身。一卦都安，才是修行的路；六爻都破，怎么是养静的窝？用爻旺的遇上青龙，宜去这个地方；忌象兴旺又加白虎，就不要去那一家。注说：各爻都占得随住处而安；一卦六冲，往来不定；用爻有气，又值青龙，利于有所往；忌象交重，又临白虎，这个地方不要去。
rule.en: The Resource line supporting the Self suits going to a schoolroom, and the fortune spirit generating the Self favours the monks' hall. The commentary says: the Resource line generating the Self suits places of letters and the homes of elders; Output generating the Self favours living with monks and Daoists and among the young; Peer generating the Self suits going to the homes of brothers and friends; Wealth generating the Self, go to the dwellings of the wife's kin, friends, servants and underlings; the Pressure line generating the Self suits above all lodging in an official's house. When the whole hexagram is at peace, that is the road of cultivation; when all six lines are broken, how could it be a nest for quiet nurture? When the Subject line is strong and meets the Azure Dragon, it suits going to this place; when the adversary image thrives and adds the White Tiger, do not go to that house. The commentary says: if all lines are divined, one is at peace wherever one lodges; a hexagram of six clashes means going and returning are unsettled; if the Subject line has qi and also holds the Azure Dragon, it is favourable to go; if the adversary image moves and sits on the White Tiger, do not go to this place.

zh: 父母扶身宜投书馆，福神生世利到僧堂。
yi: 父母爻扶身，宜去书馆；福神生世，利于去僧堂。
en: The Resource line supporting the Self suits going to a schoolroom, and Output (the fortune spirit) generating the Self favours the monks' hall.

zh: 父母生世，宜往文墨之所及尊长之家。
子孙生世，利居僧道之门、并卑幼之处。
兄弟生世，宜到弟兄朋友之家，妻财生世，当往妻族友仆隶下人之寓。
官鬼生世，偏宜宦宅安身。
yi: 父母爻生世，宜去文墨的地方和长辈的家。
子孙生世，利于住在僧道的门下和晚辈小孩的地方。
兄弟生世，宜去兄弟朋友的家；妻财生世，应去妻族亲友、仆隶下人的住处。
官鬼生世，偏宜在官宦人家安身。
en: The Resource line generating the Self suits places of letters and the homes of elders.
Output generating the Self favours living with monks and Daoists and among the young.
Peer generating the Self suits going to the homes of brothers and friends; Wealth generating the Self, go to the dwellings of the wife's kin, friends, servants and underlings.
The Pressure line generating the Self suits above all lodging in an official's house.

zh: 一卦皆安，方是修行之路。
六爻尽破，岂为养静之窝？
用爻旺者遇青龙，宜行此地。
岂象兴而加白虎，弗往其家。
yi: 一卦都安，才是修行的路；
六爻都破，怎么是养静的窝？
用爻旺的遇上青龙，宜去这个地方；
忌象兴旺又加白虎，就不要去那一家。
en: When the whole hexagram is at peace, that is the road of cultivation;
when all six lines are broken, how could it be a nest for quiet nurture?
when the Subject line is strong and meets the Azure Dragon, it suits going to this place;
when the adversary image thrives and adds the White Tiger, do not go to that house.

zh: 诸爻俱卜随寓而安，一卦六冲，往返不定。
用爻有气，更值青龙，利有攸往。
忌象交重，又临白虎，此处休行。
yi: 各爻都占得随住处而安；一卦六冲，往来不定。
用爻有气，又值青龙，利于有所往。
忌象交重，又临白虎，这个地方不要去。
en: If all lines are divined, one is at peace wherever one lodges; a Six-Clash hexagram means going and returning are unsettled.
If the Subject line has qi and also holds the Azure Dragon, it is favourable to go.
If the adversary image moves and sits on the White Tiger, do not go to this place.

note.yi: 原文「诸爻俱卜随寓而安」的「卜」疑是「安」之误（诸爻俱安），这里按字面译作「各爻都占得」，读法没有把握。这一条把去哪里养病、避暑用六亲生世来选：生世的六亲是什么，就去那一类人家。第一句的六亲和第二句（LY.ILL.EL.23）是同一件事的一体两面：前面看世爻和官鬼动不动，这里看谁生世。「六冲，往返不定」与 LY.ILL.EL.15 的六冲是两码事：这里是住处不定，不是病的缓急。
note.en: The 'bu' (divined) in 'if all lines are divined, one is at peace wherever one lodges' looks like an error for 'an' (all lines at peace), and is translated literally, the reading being uncertain. This entry chooses where to convalesce or escape the heat by which of the six relations generates the Self: whichever relation generates it, go to that kind of household. It is the other face of the previous entry (LY.ILL.EL.23): that looked at the Self line and whether the Pressure line moves, and this looks at what generates the Self. 'A hexagram of six clashes means going and returning are unsettled' is a different matter from the Six-Clash of LY.ILL.EL.15: here it is that the lodging is unsettled, not that the illness is fast or slow.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 71: Warding off calamity and escaping the heat
units.title: 避暑养病途中的忌象：动见螣蛇愁惊恐、驿马交逢虑奔驰、玄武值鬼兴失财欠利、朱雀临兄动绕舌不宁；八宫鬼动各有所忌（艮忌山岭、坎忌江湖、震忌船内东行、乾忌庙宇、兑财变官毋贪色、巽忌风、离忌火惊、坤忌墓侧）；咸池华盖；世在内卦宜居迩、外卦利遐方

rule.yi: 动的爻见到螣蛇，还怕惊恐；交遇驿马，更担心奔波劳顿；玄武值鬼爻兴旺，失财欠利；朱雀临兄爻发动，饶舌不宁。艮卦有官，不要登山岭；坎宫见鬼，不要去江湖；在震，正东惹祸；临乾，西北招殃；兑里财变官爻，尤忌色迷；巽里兄弟的鬼象，风患难防。注说：螣蛇动，如果遇上惊惶；驿马临兄爻、鬼爻动，不利于出游；驿马动，临财、福，千里都安；鬼临玄武发动，必遭失脱；朱雀值兄爻发动，是非要谨慎。艮宫鬼动，忌去东北，不要去山林；坎卦鬼动，北方不利，水池不合宜；震宫鬼动，不要待在船里，并且忌向东行；乾宫西北为凶，不要游庙宇；兑宫鬼动，必有吵闹是非，若是财变官爻，不要贪美色；巽卦鬼兴以及兄爻化鬼的，都怕冒风；离宫鬼动，虑见火惊；坤卦鬼兴，不要住在墓旁。主合咸池，不要贪美色；用爻冲华盖、或华盖克用爻、或鬼临华盖动，都怕僧道的门下惹祸，如果去避暑却灾就成凶，只有悟道修行，反而成正果。又看世爻在内卦、兴亲宫，宜居在近处；世临他宫、兴外卦，利在远方；内卦旺，本地如意；外卦旺，他乡遂意。
rule.en: A moving line seeing the Coiling Snake still fears fright; meeting the Post Horse, it further worries about rushing about; the Dark Tortoise on a thriving Pressure line loses wealth and lacks profit; the Vermilion Bird on a moving Peer line brings gossip and unrest. Gen with a Pressure line: do not climb the mountain ridges; Kan with a ghost: do not go to river and lake; in Zhen, misfortune in the due east; on Qian, calamity from the northwest; in Dui, Wealth changing into a Pressure line, beware above all of being lost in lust; in Xun, the ghost image of Peer, wind sickness is hard to guard against. The commentary says: the Coiling Snake moving, one may meet a fright; the Post Horse on a Peer or a moving Pressure line is unfavourable for travel; the Post Horse moving on Wealth or the fortune spirit, all is safe for a thousand li; the ghost on the Dark Tortoise moving, loss is sure; the Vermilion Bird on a moving Peer line, take care of quarrels. A ghost moving in the Gen palace: avoid going northeast, do not go to the mountains and forest; a ghost stirring in Kan: the north is unfavourable and pools are unsuitable; a ghost moving in Zhen: do not stay in a boat, and avoid going east; the northwest of Qian is ominous, do not visit temples; a ghost moving in Dui, there will surely be an uproar and quarrel, and if Wealth changes into a Pressure line, do not covet beauty; a ghost thriving in Xun, or a Peer line turning into a ghost, both fear exposure to wind; a ghost moving in Li, fear a fright from fire; a ghost thriving in Kun, do not live beside graves. If the Subject combines with Xianchi, do not covet beauty; if the Subject clashes Huagai, or Huagai controls the Subject line, or a ghost on Huagai moves, trouble is feared at the doors of monks and Daoists, and if one goes to escape the heat and ward off calamity it turns ominous, whereas realising the Way and cultivating oneself on the contrary bears true fruit. Also look at the Self: in the inner trigram, thriving in a kin palace, it suits living near; the Self in another palace, thriving in the outer trigram, favours a far place; a strong inner trigram means the home region is as one wishes, and a strong outer trigram means a foreign land is as one wishes.

zh: 动见螣蛇，还愁惊恐。
交逢驿马，更虑奔驰。
武值鬼爻兴，失财欠利。
雀临兄象动，绕舌不宁。
yi: 动的爻见到螣蛇，还怕惊恐；
交遇驿马，更担心奔波劳顿；
玄武值鬼爻兴旺，失财欠利；
朱雀临兄象发动，饶舌不宁。
en: A moving line seeing the Coiling Snake still fears fright;
meeting the Post Horse, it further worries about rushing about;
the Dark Tortoise on a thriving Pressure line loses wealth and lacks profit;
the Vermilion Bird on a moving Peer image brings gossip and unrest.

zh: 螣蛇动，倘遇惊惶。
驿马临兄鬼动，不利游行。
驿马动，临财福，千里皆安。
鬼临玄武交重，必遭失脱。
雀值兄爻发动，是非当谨。
yi: 螣蛇动，如果遇上惊惶。
驿马临兄爻、鬼爻动，不利于出游。
驿马动，临财、福，千里都安。
鬼临玄武发动，必遭失脱。
朱雀值兄爻发动，是非要谨慎。
en: The Coiling Snake moving, one may meet a fright.
The Post Horse on a Peer line or a moving Pressure line is unfavourable for travel.
The Post Horse moving on Wealth or the fortune spirit, all is safe for a thousand li.
The ghost on the Dark Tortoise moving, loss is sure.
The Vermilion Bird on a moving Peer line, take care of quarrels.

zh: 艮卦有官休登山岭，坎宫见鬼莫往江湖。
在震，则正东惹祸，
临乾，则西北招殃。
兑中财变官爻，色迷尤忌。
巽内兄之鬼象，风患难防。
yi: 艮卦有官，不要登山岭；坎宫见鬼，不要去江湖；
在震，就是正东惹祸；
临乾，就是西北招殃；
兑里财变官爻，尤其忌讳色迷；
巽里兄弟的鬼象，风患难防。
en: Gen with a Pressure line: do not climb the mountain ridges; Kan with a ghost: do not go to river and lake;
in Zhen, misfortune in the due east;
on Qian, calamity from the northwest;
in Dui, Wealth changing into a Pressure line, beware above all of being lost in lust;
in Xun, the ghost image of Peer, wind sickness is hard to guard against.

zh: 艮宫鬼动，忌行东北，莫往山林。
坎卦鬼摇，北方不利，水池非宜。
震鬼莫居船内，并忌东行。
乾宫西北为凶，莫游庙宇。
兑宫鬼动，必有闹非。
若财变官爻，毋贪美色。
巽卦鬼兴及兄化鬼者，皆恐冒风。
离宫鬼动，虑见火惊。
坤卦鬼兴，莫居墓侧。
yi: 艮宫鬼动，忌去东北，不要去山林。
坎卦鬼动，北方不利，水池不合宜。
震宫鬼动，不要待在船里，并且忌向东行。
乾宫西北为凶，不要游庙宇。
兑宫鬼动，必有吵闹是非。
如果财变官爻，不要贪美色。
巽卦鬼兴以及兄爻化鬼的，都怕冒风。
离宫鬼发动，要提防见火受惊。
坤卦鬼兴，不要住在墓旁。
en: A ghost moving in the Gen palace: avoid going northeast, do not go to the mountains and forest.
A ghost stirring in Kan: the north is unfavourable and pools are unsuitable.
A ghost moving in Zhen: do not stay in a boat, and avoid going east.
The northwest of Qian is ominous, do not visit temples.
A ghost moving in Dui, there will surely be an uproar and quarrel.
If Wealth changes into a Pressure line, do not covet beauty.
A ghost thriving in Xun, or a Peer line turning into a ghost, both fear exposure to wind.
A ghost moving in Li, fear a fright from fire.
A ghost thriving in Kun, do not live beside graves.

zh: 主合咸池，休贪美色，用冲华盖、或华盖克用爻、或鬼临华盖动，皆恐僧道之门惹祸，如却灾避暑去，则成凶，惟有悟道修行，反成正果。
又看世在内卦兴亲宫，宜居在迩。
世临他官兴外卦，利在遐方。
内卦旺，本境如心。
外卦旺，他乡遂意。
yi: 主合咸池，不要贪美色；用爻冲华盖、或华盖克用爻、或鬼临华盖动，都怕僧道的门下惹祸，如果去避暑却灾就成凶，只有悟道修行，反而成正果。
又看世爻在内卦、兴亲宫，宜居在近处。
世临他宫、兴外卦，利在远方。
内卦旺，本地如意。
外卦旺相，在他乡就称心如意。
en: If the Subject combines with Xianchi, do not covet beauty; if the Subject clashes Huagai, or Huagai controls the Subject line, or a ghost on Huagai moves, trouble is feared at the doors of monks and Daoists, and if one goes to escape the heat and ward off calamity it turns ominous, whereas realising the Way and cultivating oneself on the contrary bears true fruit.
Also look at the Self: in the inner trigram, thriving in a kin palace, it suits living near.
The Self in another palace, thriving in the outer trigram, favours a far place.
A strong inner trigram means the home region is as one wishes.
A strong outer trigram means a foreign land is as one wishes.

note.yi: 这一条把避暑、养病路上的忌象分成三层：六神和神煞（螣蛇惊恐、驿马奔波、玄武失财、朱雀口舌）、八宫鬼动的方位和处所（与 LY.ILL.EL.04 的八宫是同一套）、咸池华盖（色、僧道）。最后一段讲去近处还是远方：世在内卦、亲宫，住近处；世在外卦、他宫，去远方。原文「兑中财变官爻，色迷尤忌」是说兑宫里财爻变官爻，要小心迷恋美色。「千里皆安」是说驿马动而临财、福，出远门也平安。
note.en: This entry sorts the taboos on the road to escape the heat or convalesce into three layers: the six spirits and spirit-stars (the Coiling Snake fright, the Post Horse rushing about, the Dark Tortoise loss of wealth, the Vermilion Bird gossip), the direction and place indicated by a ghost moving in each of the eight palaces (the same set as in LY.ILL.EL.04), and Xianchi and Huagai (lust, monks and Daoists). The last paragraph speaks of near or far: the Self in the inner trigram or a kin palace means living near; the Self in the outer trigram or another palace means going to a far place. 'In Dui, Wealth changing into a Pressure line, beware above all of being lost in lust' means in the Dui palace a Wealth line turning into a Pressure line calls for care against infatuation. 'All is safe for a thousand li' means that with the Post Horse moving on Wealth or the fortune spirit even a long journey is safe.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 72: Seeking a doctor to treat illness
units.title: 求医疗病：子为药剂应为医，福德交重病必驱，鬼旺福灾病不治，官衰子旺患能除，应空只恐人难遇，子陷还愁药不宜；子发动药奏神功；官鬼太旺子休囚不愈；父发动药力全空，父与兄弟同发子赖兄生药有效

rule.yi: 以子孙为主，应象为凭。子孙是药剂，应爻是医生；福德发动，病必被驱走；鬼旺、福衰，灾病治不好；官鬼衰、子孙旺，病患能除；应爻空，只怕遇不到医生；子孙陷落，还愁药不对症。注说：凡是求医，子孙是用象，子孙如果发动，药就奏神功；其中官鬼太旺，子孙休囚，这个灾不会好；官鬼如果衰弱、福神兴隆，再得到应克世爻、或外卦伤内卦，一定遇到良医，没有灾不好的；如果内克外、以及世克应、子孙旺相，还行；子孙再休囚，药就没有效验，月将伤官铲有余；鬼如果遇上生财、或动，子孙纵然发动也成空虚。父爻如果发动，药力全空；父爻与兄弟同时发动，子孙靠兄弟生，那药有效；如果得到月建、或日辰克制官爻，就像遇到岐伯；倘或鬼临日月、或鬼持世卦，虽然有子孙药也无功；又如子孙、财爻并发，官鬼伏着、财爻扶它，怎么能治病？财爻、子孙纵然发动，卦里没有鬼或鬼空，仍然有效；凡是论医药，若得子孙上卦，官鬼父母两方都安，应爻不空亡，才有效。
rule.en: Output is the medicine and the Other is the doctor. The fortune spirit moving, the illness is surely driven out; the ghost strong and the fortune spirit weak, the calamity cannot be treated; the Pressure line weak and Output strong, the affliction can be removed; the Other Void, one fears only that the man is hard to meet; Output fallen, one worries still that the medicine is unsuitable. The commentary says: in seeking a doctor Output is the Subject image, and if Output moves the medicine works wonders; where the Pressure line is too strong and Output resting or trapped, the calamity is not cured; if the Pressure line is weak and the fortune spirit thriving, and further the Other controls the Self line or the outer trigram wounds the inner trigram, one is sure to meet a Lu Bian-like physician and no calamity is not cured; if the inner controls the outer, or the Self controls the Other, and Output is strong, it is still fine; if Output is again resting or trapped the medicine has no effect, the Month general wounding the official and planing off what is in excess; if the ghost meets generation of Wealth, or moves, even if Output moves it is hollow. If the Resource line moves, the power of the medicine is wholly empty; if the Resource and Peer lines move together, Output depends on Peer to generate it and the medicine is effective; if the Month or the Day controls the Pressure line, it is as if one met Qi Bo; if the ghost sits on the Day or Month, or the ghost holds the Self, then even with Output as medicine there is no effect; again, if Output and Wealth both move, the Pressure line hidden and supported by Wealth, how can the illness be treated? If Wealth and Output move but the hexagram has no ghost or the ghost is Void, it is still effective; in all discussion of medicine, it works only if Output is in the hexagram, the Pressure line and the Resource line are both at peace, and the Other is not Void.

zh: 以子孙为主，应象为凭。
yi: 以子孙为主，以应象为凭。
en: Output is the main line, and the Other image is the ground.

zh: 子为药剂应为医，福德交重病必驱，
鬼旺福灾病不治，官衰子旺患能除，
应空只恐人难遇，子陷还愁药不宜。
yi: 子孙是药剂，应爻是医生，福德发动，病必被驱走；
鬼旺、福衰，灾病治不好；官鬼衰、子孙旺，病患能除；
应爻空，只怕遇不到医生；子孙陷落，还愁药不对症。
en: Output is the medicine and the Other is the doctor; the fortune spirit moving, the illness is surely driven out;
the ghost strong and the fortune spirit weak, the calamity cannot be treated; the Pressure line weak and Output strong, the affliction can be removed;
the Other Void, one fears only that the man is hard to meet; Output fallen, one worries still that the medicine is unsuitable.

zh: 凡卜求医，子为用象，子如发动，药奏神功。
其中官鬼太旺，子值休囚此灾不愈。
官如衰弱福值兴隆，更得应克世爻、或外伤内卦，必遇卢医，灾无不瘥。
如内克外、及世克应、子孙旺相，还可。
子再休囚，药无效验，月将伤官铲有余。
鬼若遇生财或动，子孙纵发作空虚。
yi: 凡是求医，子孙是用象，子孙如果发动，药就奏神功。
其中官鬼太旺，子孙休囚，这个灾不会好。
官鬼如果衰弱、福神兴隆，再得到应克世爻、或外卦伤内卦，一定遇到良医，没有灾不好的。
如果内克外、以及世克应、子孙旺相，还行。
子孙再休囚，药就没有效验，月将伤官铲有余。
鬼如果遇上生财、或动，子孙纵然发动也成空虚。
en: In seeking a doctor Output is the Subject image, and if Output moves the medicine works wonders.
Where the Pressure line is too strong and Output resting or trapped, the calamity is not cured.

If the Pressure line is weak and the fortune spirit thriving, and further the Other controls the Self line or the outer trigram wounds the inner trigram, one is sure to meet a Lu Bian-like physician and no calamity is not cured.
If the inner controls the outer, or the Self controls the Other, and Output is strong, it is still fine.
If Output is again resting or trapped the medicine has no effect, the Month general wounding the official and planing off what is in excess.
If the ghost meets generation of Wealth, or moves, even if Output moves it is hollow.

zh: 父如发动，药力全空。
父与兄弟同发，子赖兄生，其药有效。
若得月建、或日辰克制官爻，如逢岐伯。
倘或鬼临日月、或鬼持世卦，虽有子药亦无功。
又如子财并发，官伏财扶，岂能治病？
财子纵发，卦无鬼或鬼空，仍复有效。
凡论医药，若得子孙上卦，官父两安，应不空亡，方其效也。
yi: 父爻如果发动，药力全空。
父爻与兄弟同时发动，子孙靠兄弟生，那药有效。
如果得到月建、或日辰克制官爻，就像遇到岐伯。
倘或鬼临日月、或鬼持世卦，虽然有子孙药也无功。
又如子孙、财爻并发，官鬼伏着、财爻扶它，怎么能治病？
财爻、子孙纵然发动，卦里没有鬼或鬼空，仍然有效。
凡是论医药，若得子孙上卦，官鬼父母两方都安，应爻不空亡，才有效。
en: If the Resource line moves, the power of the medicine is wholly empty.
If the Resource and Peer lines move together, Output depends on Peer to generate it and the medicine is effective.
If the Month or the Day controls the Pressure line, it is as if one met Qi Bo.
If the ghost sits on the Day or Month, or the ghost holds the Self, then even with Output as medicine there is no effect.
Again, if Output and Wealth both move, the Pressure line hidden and supported by Wealth, how can the illness be treated?
If Wealth and Output move but the hexagram has no ghost or the ghost is Void, it is still effective.
In all discussion of medicine, it works only if Output is in the hexagram, the Pressure line and the Resource line are both at peace, and the Other is not Void.

note.yi: 「卢医」是扁鹊（卢地的医），泛指高明的医生；「岐伯」是传说中黄帝的医官，也是良医的代称。原文这一句「月将伤官铲有余」指子孙休囚时，月将来伤官鬼，把官鬼的多余之势铲掉——这一句前后的连接不很清楚，这里按字面译。这一章和黄金策医药章（LY.ILL.HJC.58 到 HJC.92）是同一路读法：子孙是药，应爻是医，官鬼是病；子旺官衰药灵，官旺子衰不愈；父爻动克子孙则药力空；财爻生官鬼则药误。与易冒医药章（LY.ILL.YM.34 到 YM.36）、增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.26 到 ZS.34）也一致。
note.en: 'A Lu physician' is Bian Que (the physician of Lu), used for any skilled doctor, and 'Qi Bo' is the legendary physician-official of the Yellow Emperor, also a name for an excellent doctor. The line 'the Month general wounding the official and planing off what is in excess' means that when Output is resting or trapped, the Month general comes to wound the Pressure line and plane off its excess strength; how it connects with what surrounds it is not very clear, and it is translated literally. This chapter reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's chapter on medicine (LY.ILL.HJC.58 to HJC.92): Output is the medicine, the Other is the doctor, and the Pressure line is the illness; Output strong and Pressure weak means the medicine works, Pressure strong and Output weak means no cure; the Resource line moving and controlling Output empties the power of the medicine; Wealth generating the Pressure line means the medicine goes wrong. It also agrees with the Yi Mao's chapter on medicine (LY.ILL.YM.34 to YM.36) and the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.26 to ZS.34).

units.title: 医家治病（医生自占）：应为病者世为医，子为药效鬼为灾；鬼强子弱殃难解、福旺官柔病渐衰；应上坐官真疾病、身中带福妙医才；世克应灾当瘥、应生身宾主谐；子动兄安财静旺得多财；应空他不迎吾救、世陷吾非治彼灾

rule.yi: 以子孙为主，世应为凭。应是病人，世是医生；子孙是药效，鬼是灾；鬼强、子孙弱，殃难解；福旺、官柔，病渐衰；应上坐着官鬼，是真疾病；身上带福，是妙医才。世如果克应，灾当痊愈；应如果生世，确实是宾主相合；子动、兄安、财静旺，仙丹妙剂多得财；应空，他不迎我去救；世陷落，我治不了他的灾。注说：医生自己来占，反而把应当作病人，世是自己，子孙是药效，鬼是灾殃：官旺子衰、或官动子静，病一定难医；子动官静、或子旺官柔，药没有不灵验的；应如果临官，病真的无法治；世如果值福，治病能痊愈。世克应爻、或内克外卦，能治好他的灾；应如果生世以及外卦生内爻、或卦逢六合，是有为而来、宾主相得；妻财旺相，子孙交重发动，鬼静兄弟安，药灵而利益加倍；应值空亡，他必定无心就我；世居空地，自己心里萎靡懒散，医恐怕做不成。
rule.en: Output is the main line, and the Self and the Other are the ground. The Other is the patient and the Self is the doctor; Output is the effect of the medicine and the ghost is the calamity; the ghost strong and Output weak, the misfortune is hard to resolve; the fortune spirit strong and the Pressure line soft, the illness gradually wanes; a Pressure line sitting on the Other means a real illness; the fortune spirit on the body means a marvellous physician. If the Self controls the Other, the calamity should heal; if the Other generates the Self, host and guest truly accord; Output moving, Peer at peace and Wealth still and strong, elixir and wonderful remedy earn much wealth; the Other Void, he does not welcome my rescue; the Self fallen, I cannot cure his calamity. The commentary says: when a doctor himself divines, on the contrary the Other is taken as the patient, the Self as himself, Output as the effect of the medicine and the ghost as the calamity: with Pressure strong and Output weak, or Pressure moving and Output still, the illness is surely hard to treat; with Output moving and Pressure still, or Output strong and Pressure soft, the medicine is never without effect; if the Other sits on Pressure, the illness is real and cannot be treated; if the Self holds the fortune spirit, the treatment can heal. The Self controlling the Other line, or the inner trigram controlling the outer, can cure his calamity; if the Other generates the Self, or the outer generates the inner line, or the hexagram meets six-combine, one comes with purpose and host and guest suit each other; Wealth strong, Output moving, the ghost still and Peer at peace, the medicine is effective and the profit doubled; if the Other is Void, he surely has no heart to come to me; if the Self sits in Void, my own heart is dispirited and lazy, and the doctor may not succeed.

zh: 以子孙为主，世应为凭。
yi: 以子孙为主，以世应为凭。
en: Output is the main line, and the Self and the Other are the ground.

zh: 应为病者世为医，子为药效鬼为灾，
鬼强子弱殃难解，福旺官柔病渐衰，
应上坐官真疾病，身中带福妙医才。
yi: 应是病人，世是医生；子孙是药效，鬼是灾；
鬼强、子孙弱，殃难解；福旺、官柔，病渐衰；
应上坐着官鬼，是真疾病；身上带福，是妙医才。
en: The Other is the patient and the Self is the doctor; Output is the effect of the medicine and the ghost is the calamity;
the ghost strong and Output weak, the misfortune is hard to resolve; the fortune spirit strong and the Pressure line soft, the illness gradually wanes;
a Pressure line sitting on the Other means a real illness; the fortune spirit on the body means a marvellous physician.

zh: 医人来卜，反把应为病体，世乃自身，子为药效，鬼作灾殃，官旺子衰或官摇子静，病决难医。
子动官静、或子旺官柔，药无不效，应若临官，病真莫疗。
世如值福，治病能痊。
yi: 医生自己来占，反而把应当作病人，世是自己，子孙是药效，鬼是灾殃：官旺子衰、或官动子静，病一定难医。
子动官静、或子旺官柔，药没有不灵验的；应如果临官，病真的无法治。
世如果值福，治病能痊愈。
en: When a doctor himself divines, on the contrary the Other is taken as the patient, the Self as himself, Output as the effect of the medicine and the ghost as the calamity: with Pressure strong and Output weak, or Pressure moving and Output still, the illness is surely hard to treat.
With Output moving and Pressure still, or Output strong and Pressure soft, the medicine is never without effect; if the Other sits on Pressure, the illness is real and cannot be treated.
If the Self holds the fortune spirit, the treatment can heal.

zh: 世如克应灾当瘥，应若生身实主谐，
子动兄安财静旺，仙丹妙剂获多财。
应空他不迎吾救，世陷吾非治彼灾。
yi: 世如果克应，灾当痊愈；应如果生世，确实是宾主相合；
子动、兄安、财静旺，仙丹妙剂多得财；
应空，他不迎我去救；世陷落，我治不了他的灾。
en: If the Self controls the Other, the calamity should heal; if the Other generates the Self, host and guest truly accord;
Output moving, Peer at peace and Wealth still and strong, elixir and wonderful remedy earn much wealth;
the Other Void, he does not welcome my rescue; the Self fallen, I cannot cure his calamity.

zh: 世克应爻、或内克外卦，能疗其灾。
应如生世及外生内爻、或卦逢六合，有为而来主宾相得。
妻财旺相，子值交重，鬼静兄安，药且灵而利倍得。
应值空亡，彼必无心就我。
世居空地己心悚懒，医恐不成。
yi: 世克应爻、或内克外卦，能治好他的灾。
应如果生世以及外卦生内爻、或卦逢六合，是有为而来、宾主相得。
妻财旺相，子孙交重发动，鬼静兄弟安，药灵而利益加倍。
应值空亡，他必定无心就我。
世居空地，自己心里萎靡懒散，医恐怕做不成。
en: The Self controlling the Other line, or the inner trigram controlling the outer, can cure his calamity.
If the Other generates the Self, or the outer generates the inner line, or the hexagram meets six-combine, one comes with purpose and host and guest suit each other.
Wealth strong, Output moving, the ghost still and Peer at peace, the medicine is effective and the profit doubled.
If the Other is Void, he surely has no heart to come to me.
If the Self sits in Void, my own heart is dispirited and lazy, and the doctor may not succeed.

note.yi: 这一章的立场和上一章（LY.ILL.EL.26）相反：上一章是病家占，应是医生、世是病人；这一章是医生自己占，应是病人、世是医生。其余不变：子孙是药，官鬼是病。这和易冒医药章里医生问的四问（LY.ILL.YM.38 到 YM.41）是同一件事：易冒说「医问疾可疗乎，以应为先务，盖应为病人」，与这里「应为病者世为医」相同。这一章讲医生自己占两件事：病能不能治（子孙对官鬼），和这趟医有没有酬谢（财爻、应世关系）。「六合」按这个写法译作 six-combine。
note.en: This chapter stands opposite to the last (LY.ILL.EL.26): there the patient's family divined, and the Other was the doctor and the Self the patient; here the doctor himself divines, and the Other is the patient and the Self the doctor. The rest is unchanged: Output is the medicine and the Pressure line the illness. It is the same matter as the four questions the doctor asks in the Yi Mao's chapter on medicine (LY.ILL.YM.38 to YM.41): the Yi Mao's 'when a doctor asks whether an illness can be treated, the Other comes first, for to him the Other is the patient' agrees with this chapter's 'the Other is the patient and the Self the doctor'. The chapter treats two matters for a doctor's own divination: whether the illness can be treated (Output against the Pressure line), and whether this visit will bring a fee (the Wealth line, and the relation of Other and Self).

units.title: 医家占酬谢与阻碍：兄动倘遭同辈阻、财空休望谢金来、六冲岂得终其事、官化官忧病复乖、应克世身兄雀动反遭非讼莫开怀

rule.yi: 兄弟发动，倘若遭遇同辈阻挠；财空，不要指望谢金来；六冲，怎么能把事做完；官化官，担心病又变糟；应克世身、兄弟和朱雀发动，反而遭到是非和官司，不要开怀。注说：兄弟发动或克世爻，一定被同行霸占；木如果遇空，药金不要指望；六冲的卦，医治不能有始有终；鬼变出鬼爻、或卦里有两个官鬼都动，病重又变病，怎么能治？应如果克世，兄动、财空，又加上朱雀吵嚷，不光求不到谢礼，反而惹来闲是非。
rule.en: Peer moving, he may meet obstruction from his fellows; Wealth Void, do not look for the fee; a Six-Clash hexagram, how can the matter be finished; Pressure changing into Pressure, one worries the illness turns bad again; the Other controlling the Self, Peer and the Vermilion Bird moving, one meets quarrels and lawsuits instead, and should not be light-hearted. The commentary says: Peer moving or controlling the Self line, one is surely muscled out by fellow physicians; if Wood is Void, do not look for medicine money; in a Six-Clash hexagram the treatment cannot have a beginning and an end; if the ghost changes into a Pressure line, or the hexagram has two Pressure lines both moving, the illness changes again into another, and how can it be treated? If the Other controls the Self, and Peer moves, Wealth is Void and the Vermilion Bird adds its noise, one not only fails to get the fee but brings on idle quarrels.

zh: 兄动倘遭同辈阻，财空休望谢金来，
六冲岂得终其事，官化官忧病复乖，
应克世身兄雀动，反遭非讼莫开怀。
yi: 兄弟发动，倘若遭遇同辈阻挠；财空，不要指望谢金来；
六冲，怎么能把事做完；官化官，担心病又变糟；
应克世身、兄弟和朱雀发动，反而遭到是非和官司，不要开怀。
en: Peer moving, he may meet obstruction from his fellows; Wealth Void, do not look for the fee;
a Six-Clash hexagram, how can the matter be finished; Pressure changing into Pressure, one worries the illness turns bad again;
the Other controlling the Self, Peer and the Vermilion Bird moving, one meets quarrels and lawsuits instead, and should not be light-hearted.

zh: 兄弟发动或克世爻，必被同袍霸占。
木若逢空，药金莫望。
六冲之卦，医不始终。
鬼化鬼爻、或卦有二官皆动，病复变病，岂能治之。
应如克世、兄动财空又加雀噪，非惟求谢，反惹闲非。
yi: 兄弟发动或克世爻，一定被同行霸占。
木如果遇空，药金不要指望。
六冲的卦，医治不能有始有终。
鬼变出鬼爻、或卦里有两个官鬼都动，病重又变病，怎么能治？
应如果克世，兄动、财空，又加上朱雀吵嚷，不光求不到谢礼，反而惹来闲是非。
en: Peer moving or controlling the Self line, one is surely muscled out by fellow physicians.
If Wood is Void, do not look for medicine money.
In a Six-Clash hexagram the treatment cannot have a beginning and an end.
If the ghost changes into a Pressure line, or the hexagram has two Pressure lines both moving, the illness changes again into another, and how can it be treated?
If the Other controls the Self, and Peer moves, Wealth is Void and the Vermilion Bird adds its noise, one not only fails to get the fee but brings on idle quarrels.

note.yi: 「木若逢空，药金莫望」的「木」是财爻（金在药上，财属木，木是金所克）——这里是说医生的酬谢（药金）靠财爻，财爻落空就没有酬金；原文没有明说「木」指财，这里按上下文理解。「非讼」是是非和词讼。这一条与易冒的往医（LY.ILL.YM.40：应克世者寡情、爻无财者薄赠）是同一件事，只是这里多讲了兄弟发动（同行争夺）和官化官（病又变）。
note.en: In 'if Wood is Void, do not look for medicine money' the 'Wood' is the Wealth line (Metal governs the medicine, Wealth belongs to Wood, and Wood is what Metal controls) — it means the doctor's fee (medicine money) depends on the Wealth line, and a Void Wealth line brings no fee; the original does not say outright that 'Wood' means Wealth, and it is taken so from the context. 'Quarrels and lawsuits' is disputes and legal action. It is the same matter as the Yi Mao's on going to treat (LY.ILL.YM.40: the Other controlling the Self means little feeling, no Wealth line means a meagre gift), except that here it adds Peer moving (fellows competing) and Pressure changing into Pressure (the illness changing again).
